title: Keep a sailing raider's tier rows through the content rollback
message:
Keep a sailing raider's tier rows through the content rollback

The raider content rollback deleted every Corsair tier row but kept a
prototype with a persisted hull. The restart retires raiders by their tier
rows, so a raider at sea came back as an ordinary public hull.

The tier rows now take the same guard as the prototypes: a prototype still
sailing keeps them until the restart retires her, and a rerun afterwards
removes what was kept. The Phase 22 rollback waits for that.

title: Hold a braced ram to the order's giver at the impact
message:
Hold a braced ram to the order's giver at the impact

shipram checked consent against the hull locked when the crew braced, but
the ram tick struck whatever hull was locked when a contact came within a
room. Relocking onto a protected player's hull after bracing against an NPC
hull let the ram skip the consent gate.

The crew now records who gave the order (ram_order replaces the ramming
flag). At the impact that player must be online and pass
vessel_fire_permitted() against the hull then locked; otherwise the crew
stands down without striking.

title: Launch NPC raiders from ambushes, with their AI and ramming
message:
Launch NPC raiders from ambushes, with their AI and ramming

Vessels study step S6 (3.3.8, 1.6). A moving player's hull at sea is
ambushed one tick in 2002 (pirate coves double it, territorial waters
halve it, neutral colors cut it sixtyfold; ships and transports once a
voyage). Her hull weight picks a raider tier and a pirate or a hunter;
the raider sails from one of the tier's prototypes (vessel_raider_tiers,
Phase 22) with the tier's fit-out, a captain on the bridge, a crew, and
a chest whose key the captain carries, and closes from beyond sight.

Her brain is Duris's: the basic AI turns the arc ready soonest onto the
quarry and keeps within its band, the advanced one projects both hulls
and works round to the weakest side; she runs out of ammunition or
holed, boards a slow quarry through the boarding contest (pirates loot
and leave, hunters fight on), and leaves the sea 600 ticks after losing
her quarry once no player watches. Killing her captain stops her. A
restart retires any raider it restored, and raiders cannot be claimed.
NPC merchants under fire run from their attacker.

shipram braces a hull to ram her locked contact at speed 6 or more, with
Duris's bow cone, chance, crash damage, fitted ram, knockdowns, and
cooldowns; the AI rams too. The hunter's pilot and retire helpers are
shared as vessel_assign_npc_pilot() and vessel_retire_npc_hull().

Raider content: sql/components/vessels_raider_content.sql and zone 700
mobiles 70020-70027 and objects 70020-70021 in lib/world/vessel_raiders,
installed on a development server by the harbor provisioner.
